whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Computer Ghar,

I noticed your computer and laptop store has solid 4.3★ reviews on SP Verma Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for repair service inquiries.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp repair quote request, laptop/desktop upgrade services, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/computerghar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Computer Ghar, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Computer Ghar on SP Verma Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp repair quote booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your core laptop & desktop services in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
